inputs.name: modelFiles.input
inputs.description: ModelInput supplies the model name, its Field[] definitions, and the adapter used to generate scaffold files. The adapter is "d1", "sqlite", or "postgres"; the name is converted to class, table, and kebab-case file names.

outputs.name: modelFiles
outputs.description: This is the generated list of planned files for the model types, model class, selected adapter, SQL migration, and model test. Each planned file has a repository-relative path and generated text in contents.
